evidence: Crystallinity of the films was characterised by X-ray diffraction while time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA) and X-ray fluorescence were used to analyse stoichiometry and possible impurities. Deposited films were also analysed by Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. Preliminary capacitance–voltage (C–V) characteristics of the Al2O3-coated B2O3 thin films were determined. Film thicknesses were measured by using the optical fitting method. Adhesion of the deposited films was evaluated by tape test.
